about.heading: What I bring to a team.
pillar.1.title: Event-driven backends
pillar.1.body: Independent services, each with its own database, talking through Kafka events and protected by JWT authentication and rate limiting. Built with Java and Spring Boot.
pillar.2.title: Safe, automated releases
pillar.2.body: CI/CD that deploys only what changed, needs no SSH keys or stored AWS credentials, and rolls back by itself when a health check fails.
pillar.3.title: A security mindset
pillar.3.body: Over a year as an application security intern taught me to read code the way an attacker does, and to write fixes developers can actually apply.
pillar.4.title: Backends for LLM products
pillar.4.body: Queues, workers and APIs that make LLM-based analysis repeatable and statistically measurable.
